answer: The sparrow counter is kept in violet and whisper reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An farming party as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That is 1844 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
